Baseline moved to published mainline OMP v18.10.2 on 2026-10-12 (issue #398). Relative to v18.8.9, the relevant paths change in: a608a9ca07c9443634e80d877d61c602099dab91 (upstream feat(ipc), closing issues #9908 and #10240), which moves collab/registry.ts onto the pi-natives IpcServer/IpcConnection transport. Each query is still one connection carrying one newline-terminated JSON request with the registry v1 bearer token and one newline-terminated JSON response; the Unix socket stays <dir>/<entryId>.sock at mode 0600, now beside a 0600 <entryId>.sock.bind.lock sidecar; an overlong path is relocated to /tmp/omp-<euid>/<hash>.sock in an owner-only 0700 directory instead of /tmp/omp-collab-<hash>/<entryId>.sock; the Windows pipe becomes \\.\pipe\omp-<entryId>-<hash>; and the host refuses Unix peers running as another uid and remote Windows clients. The gateway takes the endpoint verbatim from the discovery file, reads only .json names, already requires an owner-private socket directory and a 0600 socket, and queries as the publishing user, so it reads and sends the same bytes. PR #14387 (merge ae88edd36cb31a5004fd8e3f70ede57dbf33812d; 66277d482ff1eff7141a555af8ad23a11a69ee10) makes the host relay client send WebSocket pings every 15 s and reconnect a socket silent for 40 s, adding no relay message; PR #15260 (merge d8e57c951927fbb01326f9e5330a1185e5f49520; 57ce7ca0af291cec5b473da4335c716849c65281, a9e9bbb388471009f0043bd2e85b41b8cd5182f7, b9efa62cb0fc580c1f0fe4db282155e4cfc14d56, 00445aeeff9ce6cc66eeb9b68bd0468af43b4343, and branch merge 7a5b809cdb8dbb8991e85667ee6c95213252903e) exposes /annotate to extensions as ctx.annotations in docs/extensions.md and adds supportsEditor to extension-ui-controller.ts; PR #11798 (merge 80cf9110c9b0c0847d598abe32de8caa3ac2c671; 9bef1f7f6f0b946623b6294290733e7c17c1164d, e51cec06fc69c9613eaf1b2fb11ef515b04a1437) documents command-backed extension providers; 25d28798d9db70b72e33c37178c20cacfb601851 removes two TUI composer methods from modes/types.ts; and the 18.9.0 through 18.10.2 version bumps touch package.json. Baseline moved to published mainline OMP v18.5.1 on 2026-10-03. It is the first release carrying upstream PR #14112 (merge b1e84317b74f5171137fecec4e1c578128f3aa72; v18.5.0 predates it): a collab.autoStart launch whose relay is unreachable or times out now retries on the existing relaunch backoff, and the recovered room still publishes generation 1. Relative to v18.4.12, #14112 is the only change to the collab host and controller; guest.ts gives a CLI guest's replica its own session-ownership lease. registry.ts, settings.ts, packages/wire/src/index.ts, and packages/collab-web are unchanged, so registry v1 and the relay protocol are unchanged. Canary run 37140425389 passed all ten Linux stages and all seven supported Windows stages, with three intentional Windows keystroke-stage skips. The minimum supported host stays 18.1.20; published v0.7.3 qualification remains bound to v18.4.12, not this engineering baseline.
Additive compatibility, 2026-09-23: accept optional busy activity from upstream PR #12844, merge 1eb2f51bb4d1a4324e46cdfad5c259be9b8ccee9, reported in published OMP 18.2.9. Missing/null is unknown.

Upstream PR #11908 merged the collaboration controller and host registry, first shipped in v18.1.20; previously published gateway releases retain their fork-era pins and qualification, which do not qualify this mainline integration.

The gateway reads OMP discovery files and queries each host for metadata snapshots. View and Control links are resolved on demand; OMP requires only collab.autoStart, with no gateway-facing credential or integration patch.
Discovery endpoints are read from each owner-only file, including upstream socket-path relocation; the gateway never modifies OMP discovery state.

The embedded client keeps its collab-web provenance and npm pi-wire pin at v18.4.2. Upstream collab-web at v18.5.1 differs from v18.4.2 only in its changelog and the transcript/math.ts Markdown performance changes first shipped in v18.4.12; this host-only baseline update does not import them. Client provenance and local modifications remain recorded independently in packages/collab-client/upstream/UPSTREAM.json.

scripts/upstream-pins.ts derived the tag, commit, tree, package versions, and both native pins. The Darwin arm64 native hashes identify the official 18.5.1 npm tarball and its pi_natives.darwin-arm64.node payload; the tarball matched the registry sha512 integrity and sha1 shasum before hashing. These measured source-build inputs are not a qualification result. The script requires every relevant path to exist at the tag: collab settings live in packages/coding-agent/src/collab/settings.ts, and the earlier packages/coding-agent/src/config/settings-schema.ts entry named a file upstream deleted before v18.4.2.
